settings_desktop_hint: Where this app finds the Openbots daemon, and how to open it on your other devices.
settings_general_hint: How Openbots behaves on this device.
settings_general_verbose_hint: Show only the replies, on all your devices.
settings_general_notifications_hint: Get notified when a bot replies while Openbots is in the background.
settings_appearance_hint: Choose the mode and theme for this device.
settings_appearance_theme_hint: Each theme has light and dark colors.
settings_theme_import_hint: Paste shadcn theme CSS with :root and .dark sections. Colors and corner radius are imported; other styles are ignored.
settings_theme_preview_reply: Here is a preview of your conversation.
settings_theme_values_error: Use valid colors and a corner radius. Both modes need supported theme variables.
settings_theme_storage_error: The theme could not be saved on this device. Check that browser storage is available.
settings_models_hint: See which models your bots use and replace them together.
settings_models_empty: Create a bot to manage its model here.
settings_models_replace_hint: Only bots still using this model will change. Active replies finish with their current model. A fallback using the same model shares the primary reasoning level.
settings_models_save_error: Could not replace the models. Check that the new model is available and try again.
settings_chat_hint: How the composer sends on this device.
settings_chat_enter_desktop_hint: What Enter does in the message box. ⌘ or Ctrl + Enter always sends.
settings_chat_enter_mobile: Return key on a phone or tablet
settings_chat_enter_mobile_hint: What Return does in the message box on a touch screen.
settings_tools_hint: Rules for tool approvals, and the key for automatic approval checks.
settings_tools_rules_hint: One short rule per action, for bots set to Auto. "Ask first" wins when rules conflict.
settings_tools_rules_when_placeholder: When a bot wants to… e.g. send emails for me
settings_tools_jev_hint: Auto permission uses Jev to judge tool calls. Without a key, those calls ask you.
settings_secret_saved: Saved. Type a new value to replace it.
settings_save_error: Settings were not saved. Try again.
settings_sources_hint: Folders and files the daemon reads for every bot.
settings_sources_skills_hint: Folders with skills bots can load.
settings_sources_instructions_hint: Files such as AGENTS.md added to every bot's instructions.
settings_sources_mcp_hint: JSON files that list MCP servers.
settings_paths_error: This list was not saved. Try again.
settings_devices_revoke_error: The device was not removed. Try again.
settings_devices_revoke_description: This device loses access right away. Pair it again to use it.
settings_devices_pair_hint: Scan the code with the new device, or copy it there. The code works once and expires soon.
settings_devices_pair_error: No pairing code was created. Try again.
settings_providers_hint: Model providers your bots can use.
settings_providers_sign_out_description: Bots that use {provider} stop answering until you sign in again.
settings_providers_error: The provider did not respond. Try again.
settings_devices_pair_loopback: This code works only on this computer. To pair a phone or another computer, open Openbots through its network or Tailscale address first.
